value.rationale: Odd open domination is a natural parity-constrained graph optimization invariant. The result provides an all-parameter feasibility and minimum-weight classification with a forced shift-complement mechanism and an explicit perfect-open-domination code, which is stronger and more useful than pointwise existence tests, kernel dimension, or sporadic examples.
